name: Zoe Kirkopoulos
bio:
Zoe Kirkopoulos is a masterful tattoo artist specializing in black & gray and realism tattoos, ensuring each piece is a work of art with impeccable detail and shading. Her professionalism is reflected in the meticulous attention she gives to understanding her clients' visions and translating them into stunning tattoo designs. Beyond her artistic talent, Zoe maintains a high standard of cleanliness in her workspace, offering peace of mind to all her clients at Captain Kirks Tattoo Co.
